messages:
Aisha: FYI Solis Labs confirmed early silicon access and asked for a short runbook + comms plan. They want a joint blog mention if numbers look good. We need infra, legal signoff, and a simple announcement draft. Who can take the runbook? :wave:

Tom: I can draft the runbook and landing checklist. Will need the partners approved logo and any quote text pre-approved by their comms team. Also: do we want the marketplace listing tested during EAP or after?

Luis: Marketplace test should be after EAP IMO. For the EAP, let's focus on stability and telemetry. Ill own the benchmark template and the latency/throughput dashboard. Metrics: median latency, p99, tokens/sec, GPU utilization, power draw (if available).

Priya: Legal note: NDA v2 has a publicity clause that requires 48h pre-review for any joint mention. Ill run the EAP artifact list through legal now. Also we must ensure no raw prompt dumps are sent externally.

Aisha: Good catch. Priya, please confirm whether Solis already accepted the publicity clause. If not, pause any public-facing assets.

legal-bot: NDA status: Solis-EAP-NDA v2.1  accepted by Solis on 2025-04-01 10:12Z. Publicity clause present; 48h review required.

Tom: Noted. Runbook outline proposal: 1) Provisioning steps + pool name (solis-eap-01), 2) Artifact install (FP16 + optional int8), 3) Redaction and telemetry export, 4) Benchmark scripts, 5) Failure modes and rollback. Will post draft by EOD.

Luis: Example telemetry export snippet for redaction: 

```bash
python tools/redact_and_upload.py --input runs/2025-04-05/results.json \
  --keep keys:uid,metrics,model --hash-prompts --bucket s3://redwood-solis-eap/telemetry
```

Priya: Add to runbook: a step to record who had access to partner hardware (RBAC audit) and to rotate any partner keys after EAP. Also reminder to run scans on any partner-provided binaries in a sandbox first.

Aisha: On the comms side: Solis asked for a short bulleted announcement and a single joint chart (p50 tokens/sec vs model size). We'll only draft after metrics are validated and legal has cleared text. Who can create the chart template?

Luis: I can create chart templates in the shared sheet. Will include both absolute and normalized tokens/sec. Also include a small table of run configuration (batch size, seq len, model version).

Tom: For the marketplace: action item to verify listing metadata (model id, supported contexts, pricing policy) but after EAP. I'll add a marketplace checklist item in the runbook.

infra-bot: Resource pool solis-eap-01 created: 4x V100 reserved. Access controls: partnerships+infra teams. Artifact staging path: s3://redwood-solis-eap/artifacts/.

Aisha: Perf run cadence proposal: Mon smoke (20m), Tue microbench (3h), Wed quality + retrain (45m), Thu buffer day for re-runs. Ping partners for any required windows.

Priya: Legal will need the proposed announcement text 48 hours before publish. Please tag me when draft is ready. Also attach the redacted telemetry sample for review.

Tom: Draft announcement plan (internal): short blurb, 1 chart, partner quote placeholder, link to docs + marketplace (if cleared). Will post a first draft in ~24h.

Luis: Small ops note: include a step to run warm-up sequences to populate KV cache before measuring steady-state throughput. Example: run 500 short requests at concurrency 8 for warm-up.

Aisha: Perfect. Summary of owners: Tom (runbook + announcement draft), Luis (bench harness + charts), Priya (legal clearance), infra-bot/Raj? (provisioning  Raj take over infra if needed). Ill coordinate partner comms and schedule a 30m sync Thurs 11:00 PT.

Tom: I'll post the runbook link once created and ping legal. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
